transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. I'm here to help you today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been having a really hard time sleeping for the past five days. I also feel extremely anxious and constantly on edge, and I just can't seem to relax. I'm really hoping to get some help with this.
How long have you been feeling anxious and on edge—has it been going on for more than a few days?

Yes, it has definitely been more than just a couple of days. I have been feeling extremely on edge, tense, and completely unable to relax for exactly five days now. It has been constant the entire time.
In the week before your symptoms started, were you exposed to a traumatic event involving actual or threatened death, serious injury, or violence?

To be honest, I'm not really sure how to describe it or if I would call it that. I haven't really thought about what happened in those exact terms, as I've just been so overwhelmed by how I'm feeling right now.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "stressor",
  "question": "Can you tell me what was going on in your life just before these symptoms started—something that might have triggered this anxiety and sleep problems?"
I can't really pinpoint a specific event that triggered all of this. Everything just suddenly became incredibly overwhelming about five days ago, and I've been feeling this way ever since.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "generalized worry",
  "question": "Have you been excessively worrying about a variety of everyday things, like work, health, or family, even before this recent increase in anxiety?"
No, not really. I haven't had constant or excessive worries about everyday things like work, health, or family before this. This level of anxiety is completely new to me.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "intrusion symptoms",
  "question": "Have you been having unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks related to a distressing event that happened recently?"

Yes, I've been having very vivid and distressing nightmares that constantly wake me up and ruin my sleep. However, during the day, I don't really experience any flashbacks or unwanted memories while I'm awake.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "avoidance",
  "question": "Have you been avoiding certain places, people, or activities since this started because they remind you of the event?"
No, I haven't really been avoiding any specific places, people, or activities. I'm not really sure if that's something I've been doing since this started.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "arousal",
  "question": "Have you been feeling irritable, easily startled, or having trouble concentrating since this began?"

No, I haven't really experienced irritability, being easily startled, or trouble concentrating. I'm not really sure about those specific symptoms, as I've mostly just been feeling tense and unable to sleep.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "dissociation",
  "question": "Have you felt numb, detached, or emotionally blank since this started? Or felt like things around you aren't real?"

Yes, I've been feeling completely detached from my own body, almost like I'm an outside observer watching myself. On top of that, my surroundings have felt really surreal and dreamlike, as if everything around me isn't quite real since this started.

{
  "category": "duration",
  "subcategory": "symptoms",
  "question": "Have your symptoms been present for more than three days but less than a month?"
Yes, they have. My symptoms started exactly five days ago and have been constant ever since. So it has definitely been more than three days, but less than a month.
